name: Niiyama Masanori
source:
1st year high school student.
A straight-laced and stubborn member of the school's disciplinary committee. Once he's convinced of something, he develops tunnel vision and is obstinate. Due to his inflexible personality, he has few friends, which concerns him. He excels in kabbalah and numerological magic.
 
[Translation of [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/26/goes/]his official website profile[/URL].]
